Path-Transfer Centrality

Source: R/centrality-batch59.R
centrality_path_transfer.Rd

Path-transfer centrality (Tutzauer 2007) is the entropy of where a flow that starts at a node comes to rest. The flow never visits a node twice. At a node with \(m\) unvisited out-neighbors it stops with probability \(1/(m+1)\) and moves to each of them with the same probability. With \(p_{uv}\) the probability that a flow from \(u\) stops at \(v\), $$C_H(u) = -\sum_{v} p_{uv} \log_2 p_{uv}.$$

Usage

centrality_path_transfer(x, ...)

Arguments

x

Network input accepted by centrality.

...

Further arguments to centrality, such as enumeration_limit and normalized.

Value

A named numeric vector with one score per node, in input node order, or NA at every node when the search was cut short.

Details

Direction is used, and weights, loops and parallel edges are ignored. The score is in bits and lies between 0 and the base-2 logarithm of the number of nodes. A node without outgoing ties scores 0, because its flow can only stay. The definition follows its restatement by Oggier et al. (2019); the 2007 article was not consulted.

The number of simple paths grows exponentially with the size and density of the network. The measure is therefore costly, computed only when requested by name or through include, and it stops after enumeration_limit search steps (default one million): every score is then NA with a cograph_undefined_measure warning.

References

Tutzauer, F. (2007). Entropy as a measure of centrality in networks characterized by path-transfer flow. Social Networks, 29(2), 249-265. doi:10.1016/j.socnet.2006.10.001 .

Oggier, F., Phetsouvanh, S. and Datta, A. (2019). A split-and-transfer flow based entropic centrality. PeerJ Computer Science, 5, e220. doi:10.7717/peerj-cs.220 .

See also

centrality_transportation, centrality.

Examples

flow <- matrix(0, 5, 5, dimnames = list(1:5, 1:5))
flow[rbind(c(1, 2), c(1, 3), c(1, 4), c(3, 5), c(4, 5))] <- 1
centrality_path_transfer(flow)
#>    1    2    3    4    5 
#> 2.25 0.00 1.00 1.00 0.00
